findings.title: Do not silently discard charge failures.
findings.rationale: charge_all() catches every Exception from charge() and returns only successful receipts. This hides both gateway failures and programming errors, and callers cannot identify failed orders. Handle the defined gateway failure contract and return failure details or re-raise after recording the failed order. Do not retry a failed charge unless the gateway supports idempotency.
